description: A flood launched by devices infected with Mirai botnet malware, using GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) packets that carry IP packets inside. The target has to unwrap and handle each one, which wastes bandwidth and processing power. On the network it appears as a heavy stream of GRE traffic directed at a single target.
